x-m-el-sta-05.title: Kukanda kushoma nekukanda kwakawanda: mikana here kana kubiridzira?
x-m-el-sta-05.goal: Uchishandisa data ye simulation, tonga pfungwa iri kuseri kwe hypothesis testing: kunyangwe ne ratio imwe chete, kuoma kwekutsanangura mhedzisiro ne 'mikana' kunoenderana nehuwandu hwekuedza.
x-m-el-sta-05.material: Jihoon akakanda coin uye akati, 'Ndinofunga coin iyi yakagadzirwa kuti iwire musoro kakawanda!' Wakamhanyisa simulation ye computer kuti uone kuti mhedzisiro yakadai inoitika kakawanda sei ne coin yakarurama (coin apo musoro nemuswe zvakaenzana). Mhedzisiro ye simulation: (a) Kukanda coin yakarurama nguva 10 kwakadzokororwa nguva 1000, uye misoro 7 kana kupfuura yakabuda mu anenge 170 yazvo. (b) Kukanda coin yakarurama nguva 100 kwakadzokororwa nguva 1000, uye misoro 70 kana kupfuura haina kubuda kunyange kamwe chete. Mhedzisiro chaiyo yaJihoon ndi Case A (misoro 7 mukukanda 10) ne Case B (misoro 70 mukukanda 100).

x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa, mu simulation imwe neimwe, kuti coin yakarurama yakapawo mhedzisiro iyoyo kangani.

x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.a: Mu simulation (a), kunyangwe coin yakarurama yakapa misoro 7 kana kupfuura pa10 mu anenge 170 pa1000 runs. Mhedzisiro inoitika kakawanda haishamisi.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.b: Ose maviri ndi70% misoro, saka humbowo hune simba rakaenzana
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.b: Kunyangwe ratio yakafanana, huwandu hwakasiyana hwekukanda hunochinja kuti zvinoitika nemikana here. Enzanisa matafura e simulation (a) ne (b).
